description: Check an Arc USDC payment transaction hash for address poisoning lookalikes or OFAC SDN exposure. $0.005 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

to.description: optional recipient to evaluate when multiple transfers exist

name: wrong_pay
title: Wrong pay
